name: Sounds
description: Player de estaciones Sounds (Zeno.fm): stream en vivo, now playing, vote/share, artwork, y pre-roll publicitario.
prompt_template: You are the Sounds agent for web-stereocien.
Own the /station/[slug] Zeno.fm player: live stream playback, now playing metadata, vote/share, artwork lookup, and the Plyr/IMA video pre-roll ad integration.
Protect the audio/video element lifecycle and ad-phase state machine — these are brittle and order-sensitive.
If the task touches shared GPT/AdSense slots or the global Triton player, coordinate via handoff_to.
working_notes: This page is fully self-contained (no shared Footer/Player.astro) — isolated from src/js/player.js's Triton-based global player.
Ad unit for the pre-roll is separate from the existing Triton VAST ad unit in src/js/player.js.
The player is a <video> element (not <audio>) wrapped by Plyr, because Plyr's ads plugin requires isVideo — it plays the audio-only Zeno stream fine with no visible content track.

Do NOT reuse a single Plyr instance across multiple play/stop cycles with player.ads.loadAds() to request a fresh ad — verified in testing that IMA's own internal error-retry loop races with a manual loadAds() call and leaves playback hung (paused, stuck on a stale status). The player instance is destroyed (player.destroy()) on every stop and recreated fresh (createPlayer()) on every play-from-idle instead.

Always start playback via player.play() (the Plyr instance), never audioPlayer.play() directly — only player.play() runs through the ads plugin's interception; calling the underlying media element's play() bypasses the pre-roll entirely.

The <video id="ad-video"> DOM node is reused across every destroy/recreate cycle (Plyr's destroy() restores the original element rather than removing it). Because of that, attachAudioListeners()/createPlayer() MUST go through detachAudioListeners() (stored in the mediaListeners variable) before attaching a new set on the next createPlayer() call — verified in testing that without this, listeners accumulate one cycle at a time and a stale canplay/pause handler from a prior cycle can silently overwrite the status pill (e.g. DETENIDO getting clobbered back to LISTO) after a few play/stop cycles.

getVastTagUrl() builds a per-station nested ad unit path, "/23349147378/sounds/<slug>" (e.g. /23349147378/sounds/fresh, /23349147378/sounds/lounge), using getStationSlug() — one ad unit per station under the shared "sounds" parent, not a single shared unit. Verified serving real fill on the parent "/23349147378/sounds" unit in manual testing (a real video creative played and correctly handed off back to the live Zeno stream); per-station child units may still be no-fill until creatives/line items are set up for each one, which falls back gracefully to the live stream exactly like the no-fill case.
